command:
cat > /root/tc-shape/playbook.yml <<'ANSIBLE_EOF'
---
- name: Configure VyOS router interfaces for lan-a and lan-b
  hosts: router
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Assign addresses to eth1 (lan-a) and eth2 (lan-b) and commit
      ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: |
          bash -c '
          source /opt/vyatta/etc/functions/script-template
          configure
          set interfaces ethernet eth1 address 10.50.10.1/24
          set interfaces ethernet eth2 address 10.50.20.1/24
          commit
          save
          exit
          '
        executable: /bin/bash
      register: vyos_config
      changed_when: "'No changes' not in vyos_config.stdout"

- name: Address lan hosts and add routes to the peer subnet via node1
  hosts: lan_hosts
  become: true
  tasks:
    - name: Configure static address on the lan interface
      community.general.nmcli:
        conn_name: "Wired connection 2"
        ifname: enp8s0
        type: ethernet
        method4: manual
        ip4: "{{ lan_ip }}"
        routes4: "{{ remote_net }} {{ lan_gw }}"
        state: present

    - name: Bring the lan interface connection up
      ansible.builtin.command: nmcli connection up "Wired connection 2"
      changed_when: true

- name: Shape node2 -> node3 traffic to 1mbit on the lan-a egress interface
  hosts: node2
  become: true
  vars:
    tc_dispatcher_path: /etc/NetworkManager/dispatcher.d/99-tc-shape-lana
  tasks:
    - name: Install NetworkManager dispatcher script to reapply shaping on interface up
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: "{{ tc_dispatcher_path }}"
        mode: "0755"
        content: |
          #!/bin/sh
          # Re-applies the 1mbit egress cap on enp8s0 (lan-a, node1<->node3 path)
          # whenever NetworkManager brings the interface up, so the limit
          # survives reboots and reconnects.
          IFACE="$1"
          ACTION="$2"
          [ "$IFACE" = "enp8s0" ] || exit 0
          case "$ACTION" in
            up|dhcp4-change)
              tc qdisc replace dev enp8s0 root tbf rate 1mbit burst 32kbit latency 400ms
              ;;
          esac

    - name: Apply the 1mbit egress shaping now
      ansible.builtin.command: tc qdisc replace dev enp8s0 root tbf rate 1mbit burst 32kbit latency 400ms
      changed_when: true
ANSIBLE_EOF
